name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 8 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2026-06-22, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
